title: IAEA emergency notification, USIE/NEWS, and Early Notification Convention as emergency information rails
summary: IAEA emergency notification and Early Notification Convention surfaces are encoded as information-exchange rails for urgent nuclear/radiological events. They are separate from operating-experience reporting and do not by themselves prove complete public communication or effective emergency response.

status_history.note: Added as emergency notification/public event information rail after nuclear severe-accident records.

subjects.name: Convention on Early Notification of a Nuclear Accident

claims.claim: The IAEA says USIE is a secure website for countries to exchange urgent notifications and follow-up information during an emergency, supported by emergency contact points; it reports more than 1,000 users from over 150 Member States and says information obtained from USIE is made publicly available on the NEWS website.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises this extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The IAEA Early Notification Convention page says the convention, adopted after Chornobyl/Chernobyl, establishes a notification system for qualifying nuclear accidents with possible international transboundary radiological significance and requires reporting time, location, nature, and other assessment-essential data.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises this extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: For the cube, emergency notification rails are distinct from operating-experience rails: they are optimized for urgent verified information exchange and public event communication, not for full retrospective causal analysis or lesson infusion.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises this extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

limitations: No treaty-party legal status table extracted.
No emergency communication effectiveness audit performed.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: state/emergency contact points communicate urgent notifications and follow-up information through USIE/IAEA channels; qualifying treaty cases require notification to affected states/IAEA
limitations: notification does not equal causal analysis or corrective-action closure
public availability and timeliness require separate event-level audit

handling_notes: Emergency information can affect panic, trust, evacuation, and international relations; avoid implying that a notification rail solves communication quality.
